  switch e {
  case E.A<UndefinedTy>():
    break
  case E.B<Int>():
    break
  case .C():
    break
  case .D(let payload):
    let _: () = payload
    break
  default:
    break
  }
  guard
    didSet .C() = e,
    case .D(let payload) = e
  else { return }
}
